BluePearl Pet Hospital Tukwila - serving areas south of Seattle.
Our hospital is located about three miles east of Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, south of I-405 off Baker Boulevard. We serve pets and their families in Auburn, Burien, Covington, Des Moines, Federal Way, Fife, Issaquah, Kent, Maple Valley, Mercer Island, Newcastle, Normandy Park, Seahurst, South Seattle, Sumner, West Seattle and Tukwila.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When you have a pet emergency, seconds count. We want you to know, we’re ready 24/7/365. If your pet has a condition that requires a specialist’s expertise, we’re ready for that too. Our experienced veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
Emergency: In an emergency, call ahead to your BluePearl vet and let us know you’re coming. No appointment is necessary for our emergency vet.
Learn more about your emergency visit.
Specialty care
Specialty Care: Our veterinary specialists work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our specialists are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment.

About BluePearl Pet Hospital Tukwila.
Near the major port city of Seattle, our hospital is always ready to care for the hardworking animals of border protection.
Our doors stay open for emergencies day and night, 24 hours a day.
Diagnostic capabilities include:
Digital radiograph (x-ray)
Endoscopy
Ultrasound
CT
Among other special services, we offer non-surgical means to break up bladder and kidney stones, using lasers to pulverize them. Our hospital can provide hemodialysis to pets requiring specialized kidney treatment, therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) for treating certain immune-mediated diseases, and is equipped for laparoscopic and arthroscopic surgeries.
Formerly called Animal Critical Care and Emergency Services, or ACCES Renton, our pet hospital holds the highest level of certification awarded by the Veterinary Emergency & Critical Care Society.
Each month, we host a satellite clinic that allows pets to be seen by the Animal Dermatology Clinic of Pasadena, CA, which specializes in diagnosing and treating skin and ear diseases.
